content: {"praised":["Story explores future survival and space exploration.","Father/daughter relationship is emotionally powerful.","Themes of science and astrophysics are inspiring.","Visuals and music create immersive atmosphere.","Overall film is brilliant and highly recommended."],"criticized":["Scientific claims feel unproven and overemphasized.","Plot contains holes and lacks logical basis.","Dialogue is laughable and hard to follow.","Sound levels are appalling and actors mumble.","Tone is relentlessly depressing and confusing."]}
